state:
**Goal `serve-per-mount-config` — Stage 2 has landed; nothing on the request path uses it yet.** ADR 0271 is the goal's one record; it `modifies` the four rules the goal names, and their `because` lists carry 0271. Their prose is still the pre-goal truth and is rewritten by the stage that lands each behaviour (goal file § *Stage 0*): `rule:http-server/the-served-file-is-optional` with Stage 3/4, the scheduled-run and job rules with Stage 5.

`nvs_config::Current` now holds an `Arc<Published>`: the host's snapshot plus `AppBlocks` (the roster taken out of `Resolved` once), resolving an entry file to its own snapshot on first use and keeping it under the canonical path. Entries on one chain of blocks share one `Arc`; an entry no block matches gets the host's; every snapshot carries the host's generation and is folded after the host's `Boot` carry. `Current::load` still returns the host's, `Current::published` returns the set, `Current::publish_set` publishes host + roster + eagerly matched entries. `Current::new` and `publish`/`publish_keeping` build a host-only set, so every caller in `nvs-cli` serves exactly what it did before. The goal's five Stage 2 tests are in `crates/nvs-config/tests/snapshot.rs`, with two more (a spelling with `.`, a refused publish leaving the old set).

next.title: the request path, the door half

items.text: **`Reply::Run` carries the snapshot the program runs under** — `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:422`; the door writes it onto the context at `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:1670` and reads the disconnect keys from it at `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:1680`, while the request start at `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:1427` keeps the host's (ADR 0271 § 1).
**`Serving::policy` is handed only the host's snapshot** — `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:809`, so alternating mounts never re-derive the policy (ADR 0271 § 1, *Consequences*).
**The Stage 3 door check's named tests** — `bun nv loop --list --stage 3` prints them; they sit beside `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:1670`'s existing tests.

**Then the binary half** (its own group, next session): the handler picks the snapshot after `Table::select` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:937` via `Current::published().entry(..)`, boot builds the set with `Current::publish_set`/`Published::new` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:299`, `fall_back_to` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:1995` takes each row's origin from its own entry, and `per_request_cap` at `crates/nvs-config/src/server.rs:874` takes the largest of the global and every block's limits.

backlog: `nvs ctl config` per-application view — out of this goal (ADR 0271 § 7); a later goal if wanted.
`crates/nvs-config/src/control.rs`'s `reload` still publishes a host-only set; Stage 4 moves it to `Current::publish_set` (goal file § *Stage 4*).
